'''The Pearl''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Elgit system/Legends|Elgit system]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the space station was in disrepair. Despite this, it remained a major trading location because it was located along the intersection of [[the Dead Road]] and the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]''. The station was owned by [[Harke]].<ref name="LoNH" />
